newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Feb trade figures expected next week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Feb trade figures expected next week.

text.p: The Brazilian government expects to divulge the trade balance for February next Tuesday, a Ministry of Industry and Commerce spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said foreign trade secretary Mauricio Cortes expected import and export figures for the month to be revealed jointly.

In January, Brazil posted a deficit of $413 million after taking account of some oil imports by state oil firm Petrobras. Some fuel imports had to be transferred to February because of problems with the new Siscomex import registration system.
Up to February 23, the trade deficit for the year so far stood at $1.6 billion.
